name: Shem
summary: One of Noah's three sons, who was saved with his family in the ark. Noah praised the LORD as Shem's God, and Shem's family line led down to Abram.

key_moments.title: Saved in the Ark
key_moments.description: Shem went into the ark with his father Noah, his mother, his brothers Ham and Japheth, and their wives.

key_moments.title: Covering Their Father
key_moments.description: Shem and Japheth laid a garment on their shoulders, walked in backward and covered their father without looking at him. Noah praised the LORD as Shem's God.

key_moments.title: The Line to Abram
key_moments.description: Two years after the flood, when Shem was 100, his son Arphaxad was born. His family line went on through many generations to Terah, the father of Abram.
